title: Frontend: AI settings form — provider select, masked API key input, test connection
description: AI configuration section within settings. Allows users to select their AI provider and enter their API key securely.
acceptanceCriteria: API key input: password-type with show/hide toggle
If key is already saved: shows 'Key saved (••••••••)' and 'Update Key' option

steps.details: Create src/components/settings/AiSettingsForm.tsx. Select for provider (two options). Password input for API key with eye icon toggle. If user.hasAiKey, show masked indicator. 'Save AI Settings' button.
On submit: PATCH /api/users/me/ai-settings. On success: update authStore user (hasAiKey = true), show 'AI settings saved!' toast.
Enter OpenAI key — verify saved. Navigate away and back — verify 'Key saved' indicator shown. Try AI PM panel — verify it works with saved key.
